Host a game

Get a 5-letter code to share. Put friends on either team; bots take every empty slot of the 5v5.

Join a game

Enter the code your host shared, or open their invite link.

Connection settings (TURN relay)

If joining times out between different networks, a TURN relay fixes it. Get a free key at metered.ca/tools/openrelay (20 GB/month), create a credential, then paste its credentials URL (looks like https://yourapp.metered.live/api/v1/turn/credentials?apiKey=…). The host and each player paste it once; it’s saved in this browser.
